title: Ultraviolet Rush
description: A euphoric dance-pop anthem built on shimmering supersaw chords and a pounding 909 kick, opening with a filtered, atmospheric intro before layers of driving hats, punchy snares, and glowing arpeggios stack into a full-force peak. The track burns slowly upward and releases tension in a sparkling outro, leaving the dancefloor breathless.
